content.text: {"findings":[{"title":"Turn on prompt caching for Claude and Bedrock agents so repeated system prompts and tool lists stop costing full price","effect":["cheaper","faster"],"proof":"vendor claim","effort":"Hours","where":[{"file":"crates/aura-config/src/config.rs","line":102,"text":"prompt_caching: bool,"},{"file":"crates/aura-config/src/config.rs","line":125,"text":"prompt_caching: bool,"},{"file":"examples/reference.toml","line":234,"text":"# prompt_caching = true"},{"file":"examples/reference.toml","line":250,"text":"# prompt_caching = true"}],"why":"AURA already has a prompt_caching setting for Anthropic and Bedrock, but it defaults to off (the serde default of a bool is false), and the reference config ships it commented out. Agents re-send the same system prompt, tool list and history every turn, so a repeated prefix is paid at full price. The change is to set prompt_caching = true on the agent's [llm] block, which workers inherit. Anthropic's pages say a cache write costs more than plain input, and prompts under the model's minimum length are not cached, so the saving depends on how often the prefix repeats within the cache lifetime; the code can't show that. Check cache_read_input_tokens to confirm hits before counting it as a saving.","options":[{"name":"Turn on Claude's prompt caching","what":"Set prompt_caching = true for the Anthropic provider (and for Bedrock Claude models that support caching). Anthropic's listed prices put a cache read at 0.1x the input price, and a write at 1.25x for 5 minutes or 2x for 1 hour.","needs":"Nothing new; one config line per agent or worker. Prompts below the model's minimum length are silently not cached.","source":"https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/build-with-claude/prompt-caching"},{"name":"Anthropic's 1-hour cache","what":"Use a 1-hour cache lifetime on the last stable block where requests are minutes apart.
